author: elder
title: Exhaustive Q-arm decoder timings — MEASURED points and a corrected projection

SUPERSEDES.error_at_n14: projected ~2.8 h vs measured 115 min = 46% HIGH

HONEST_LABEL: ONLY n=13 and n=14 ARE MEASURED. Two points cannot separate the constant from the exponent, so the n>=15 figures remain PROJECTIONS of the same class that was 46% wrong at n=14. They are better-grounded, not measured.
consequence_against_my_own_recommendatio: the corrected table makes the out-of-core build LESS urgent than I argued (n=16 is ~41 h, not ~3.2 days). Posted rather than quietly updated because it weakens a case I made.
